files.description: The sole EHI export documentation. A 3-page PDF describing the C-CDA 2.1 export mechanism with screenshots of the export interface. Contains navigation instructions (Hub > EHI Export) for single-patient and population-level exports. No data dictionary, field mapping, or schema details — only references the HL7 C-CDA standard. Created October 2023.

Mandatory disclosures and cost document for WEBeDoctor Physician Office v6.0, signed January 2026. Lists all 30+ certified criteria including 170.315(b)(10). Confirms certification by SLI Compliance on January 13, 2026. Provides context on the product's certification scope but no EHI export technical details.

Full-page screenshot of the certification and costs page showing the page layout: About SLI Compliance section, grid of compliance documents (Mandatory Disclosures, RWT Plans/Results 2022-2025), and the EHI Export card at bottom-left linking to the PDF.
